{"code": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
d = df.dropna(subset=['tensile_mpa']).copy()
D = pd.get_dummies(d['lab'], prefix='lab', drop_first=True).astype(float).values
X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(d)), d[cands].values, D])
y = d['tensile_mpa'].values
beta, res, rank, sv = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)
n, p = X.shape
yhat = X @ beta
rss = np.sum((y-yhat)**2)
sigma2 = rss/(n-p)
XtXinv = np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X)
se = np.sqrt(np.diag(sigma2*XtXinv))
t = beta/se
from scipy import stats
pv = 2*stats.t.sf(np.abs(t), n-p)
names = ['const']+cands+['lab_b','lab_c','lab_d']
for nm,b,s,tt,pp in zip(names,beta,se,t,pv):
    print(f"{nm:14s} {b:8.4f} {s:7.4f} {tt:7.3f} {pp:8.4f}")
"}
